summary: the inode numbers KRFFS gives and the root gives to the old and the wide stat calls: krffs_hosttest.c's rows, then tests/host/fixtures/krffs_stat.c over the stat functions extracted unchanged from private copies of syscall_fs.c and vfs.c

argv:
set -eu
t=${WORK}/tree
sh tests/proofs/tree.sh "$t" ${SRC} rach2/sys tests/host
cd "$t"
s=rach2/sys
f=tests/host/fixtures
python3 $f/extract.py $f/krffs_stat_types.inc -f $s/arch/i686/uabi.h 'struct linux_stat' 'struct user_stat' -f $s/fs/vfs.h 'struct vfs_stat' -f $s/arch/i686/uabi.h '#define STAT_SET_INO' -f $s/syscall_fs.c 'struct kstat'
python3 $f/extract.py $f/krffs_stat_funcs.inc -f $s/syscall_fs.c path_names_dir stat64_put stat64_node_times stat64_root_times krffs_fill_stat64 stat_times_from_stat64 stat_node_times stat_root_times do_stat64 old_stat_put do_old_stat -f $s/fs/vfs.c kfs_getattr
exec ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -DRACH2_HOSTTEST -g -O1 -ffreestanding -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -Wno-pointer-to-int-cast -Wno-int-to-pointer-cast -I $s -I $s/lib -I $s/proc -o ${WORK}/krffs_stat $f/krffs_stat.c $s/lib/kstring.c $s/lib/kctypes.c

faults.name: orphan
faults.summary: an open unlinked file's inode number mixed from its name

lines: krffs_hosttest: FAIL: open unlinked siblings keep distinct unchanged inode numbers

faults.name: root-node
faults.summary: a root node that krffs_node_ino does not number 1

faults.name: root-old
faults.summary: a root that answers inode 0 to the old stat call

lines: krffs_hosttest: FAIL: root old stat inode is 1

faults.name: root-wide
faults.summary: a root that answers inode 0 to the wide stat call

lines: krffs_hosttest: FAIL: root stat64 inode is 1
